verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud separates data sources so you can update, delete, or add data in one without affecting the others (orama-docs-48). On-premise or in-your-cloud deployment lets you keep data on infrastructure you control (orama-docs-8, orama-docs-51). Beyond that one deletion mention, the pack documents no retention controls, so the story is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented delete/purge API, configurable retention periods or TTLs, a retention/deletion policy for Cloud-stored data and logs, and independent corroboration.
